openIssues: Engine err.incomplete conflates truncation with an invalid continuation byte: decode of E4 41 returns got=1 and the message says only 1 byte is present, though the second byte is present but not 10xxxxxx (TextToBinaryTool.astro:322-324). Engine and test text unchanged; out of scope.
err.overlong / err.surrogate / err.tooLarge report bytes 1-2 (the detected prefix) for 3-4 byte sequences; the wording is a prefix, not the whole sequence (TextToBinaryTool.astro:325-326).
noteControl does not count C1 controls (U+0080-U+009F); the body now states this, the runtime message wording is unchanged (TextToBinaryTool.astro:332-343).
tips.sep says Binary to Text reads every one of these separators; None is not a separator but the continuous-string path is handled (TextToBinaryTool.astro:22).
